notes.title: Small update and bug fixes
notes.notes:
Just a small update for our current Prologue for Dap.

This one is mostly for bug fixes and small improvements.

Fixes include:


Fixed crash occurring occasionally on player death
Fixed menu glitches
Updated some music
Tutorial prompts stay on screen until completed
Enemy behavior updates


Thank you all for playing!

notes.title: Prologue Update Fix
notes.notes:
We fixed an error that wouldn't allow the Prologue to be launched after yesterday's update. 
Sincere apologies to anyone who tried to play yesterday!

notes.title: Dap Prologue Update
notes.notes:
Our Prologue has received a little update!
While we are watching some of you who played live, we are continuously working to make this game the best it can be for you all. This update is mostly focusing on clarity in teaching the game's mechanics.
These updates include:


 Improvements in enemy behaviors for clarity to attack patterns
 Introducing a charge target to shoot your Dap's spells to open doors
 Improvements in audio, particularly in charging Dap's spells
 Larger tutorial text for clarity
 Clarity updates in phrasing of tutorial prompts
 Improved clarity on button prompts
 An extra room for better flow
 More smaller improvements...
